description: This file is the entry point for a React web application. It imports React, ReactDOM, a theme CSS, and the main App component. It creates a root React DOM node and renders the App component within StrictMode for development checks.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root React DOM node for rendering React components into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the specified React element Tree into the root DOM node.
